g.text: Design synthesizable RTL, build self-checking testbenches, inspect waveforms, and debug functional issues.
Combinational + sequential design, processor datapaths, protocols and hardware architecture fundamentals.
Hands-on with Xilinx Vivado and an expanding open-source workflow around simulation, synthesis and GitHub.
